text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stop by the cafeteria and find Nishino Flower lining up a sizable selection of Japanese desserts.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hi, Trainer. Just look at all this sugary goodness.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A bunch of folks from the shopping district gave them to me. They told me to eat up so I could grow up big and strong.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I'll be able to finish it all… But I need to do my best. I have to repay their kindness by eating everything and growing taller…
choice_data_list: You shouldn't force yourself to overeat.
Eating well is essential for growth!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Th-that's true… Even potted flowers wilt if you water them too much…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All right. I'll work on this pile each day instead of binging on it all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Nishino Flower is able to enjoy her gifts without overdoing it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll soldier through and show them just how big and strong I can get!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: First, I want to grow tall enough to write on the blackboard without needing a step stool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Nishino Flower shows her appreciation by eating all the desserts in one sitting.
